status: Synthetic custom binding proposal; locally pinned, not a hosted standard or qualified service.
payloadMeaning: One complete raw JPEG HTTP representation, never JSON/base64, signaling, or a live byte stream. payloadType is this profile's descriptive field, not a TD or AV term.

request.authentication: Inherited TD bearer scheme over HTTPS; issuer, audience, trust and credentials are configured out of band.

validation: Read a bounded complete response; check JPEG coding variant, initialization, dimensions and orientation against the exact codec pin. Reject truncation, type/size/dimension changes and unsupported features; never return an empty-success image.
behavior: Observe the latest existing image without configuration or trigger effects. no-cache/no-store are cache rules, not capture freshness or new-exposure evidence. Neither FPS nor age is promised.
lifetime: Complete or abort this one request and free owned buffers; do not stop shared acquisition. Refuse redirects; changed origins require repinning and a credential policy.
errors: Authentication failure, timeout, missing image, malformed media and unavailable pinned dependencies are explicit errors. HTTP failures are non-2xx, not empty JPEGs.
qualification: No endpoint, JWT verifier, image, backend, bounded-capacity claim or decoder has been exercised.
